headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain Despite Its 354% Run
headlines.summary: Strategy has been on a volatile ride, yet after a very large 3 year gain and heavy recent swings, the live question is whether a US$152.18 share price can still be squared with what its balance sheet is worth on paper. With the business now closely tied to Bitcoin moves and capital return programs, investors are increasingly asking how much of today’s valuation is backed by book value rather than market optimism around digital assets. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned about 3.

headlines.title: Strategy’s Bitcoin-Backed Preferred Shares Pay Up to About 10%. A Solana Treasury Company’s Preferred Pays 13%. What Is the Extra Yield For?
headlines.summary: Two crypto treasury companies both prioritize preferred shareholders and chase similar capital-markets strategies, yet one pays nearly double what the other's underlying asset can actually generate. Understanding that gap reveals something uncomfortable about where the money really comes from.

headlines.title: Peter Schiff Calls Strategy’s 2026 a ‘Failure’ as MSTR Bulls Push Back
headlines.summary: Peter Schiff cited a negative 3.7% year-to-date Bitcoin yield to challenge Strategy’s performance. His criticism followed the company’s announcement of another purchase of 250 BTC.

headlines.title: Strategy Bought 250 Bitcoin Last Week and Spent Nearly Nine Times That Buying Back Its Own Preferred Shares. Has the Biggest Buyer Stopped Moving the BTC Price?
headlines.summary: Strategy spent nearly nine times more cash on preferred share buybacks than on bitcoin last week, raising a question that matters to every BTC investor: has the company that built its identity around relentless bitcoin accumulation quietly lost its grip on the price?

headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) Dips More Than Broader Market: What You Should Know
headlines.summary: Strategy (MSTR) reached $152.68 at the closing of the latest trading day, reflecting a -1.08% change compared to its last close.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
